minecraft:player.entity_interaction_rang: How far a player can interact with an entity, such as attacking a hostile mob or feeding a pet.
attribute.name.generic.explosion.knockba: How much knockback that is ignored from explosions, such as from creepers or tnt.
attribute.name.generic.fall_damage_multi: Damage multiplier when falling from a  high place.
attribute.name.generic.gravity.desc: Determines how fast an entity falls, negative amounts will cause exepected levitation.
attribute.name.generic.jump_strength.des: Determines how high you can jump.
attribute.name.generic.movement_efficien: Improves the efficiency of movement speed when walking through blocks that slows down movement.
attribute.name.generic.oxygen_bonus.desc: How much extra time that can be spent underwater.
attribute.name.generic.safe_fall_distanc: The distance before you start taking fall damage.
attribute.name.generic.scale.desc: Determines the base size of an entity.
attribute.name.player.sneaking_speed.des: Movement speed while the player is sneaking.
attribute.name.generic.step_height.desc: The base distance that an entity can walk up in blocks before needing to jump.
attribute.name.player.submerged_mining_s: The speed at which a player mines underwater.
attribute.name.player.sweeping_damage_ra: Damage multiplier for a fully charged sweep attack.
attribute.name.generic.water_movement_ef: How much control an entity has while in water, also affects how much it is pushed by flowing water.
